item.title: fix(gateway): incognito reset broadcasts delete, not reset (#123333)
item.summary: fix(gateway): incognito reset broadcasts delete, not reset (#123333) performGatewaySessionReset physically deletes incognito sessions (the RPC already responds deleted:true), but the handler broadcast sessions.changed with the reset/new reason. Clients drop rows and navigate away only on reason "delete"; a non-delete reason loads the now-deleted row, gets null, and merges a rowless no-op — other tabs dead-end in a deleted chat pane and the sidebar row lingers until an unrelated refresh.
